help.nameClass: The name of the class, for example Class 6.
help.grade: The class number, for example 6; a positive whole number. Used to put classes in order.
help.academicYear: Which year the class belongs to. You can pick it only when adding; it does not change later.
help.shift: For example Morning or Day. It shows only if the school has two or more shifts.
help.version: For example Bangla or English. It shows only if there are two or more versions.
help.capacity: How many can sit in the section, for example 40. Only for display; it does not stop extra enrolments.
help.group: For example Science. It shows only if there are two or more groups.
help.subject: One of the school's active subjects.
help.optionalSubject: Tick it if not everyone studies it.
help.teacher: Someone who has a teacher profile.
help.assignmentType: Class teacher, Assistant class teacher or Subject teacher.
